_about: GitHub App manifest template (AppID lane). Substitute the <ANGLE> placeholders, extract the .manifest object, and feed it to the lane manifest tool (form mode). The manifest is non-secret; ALL credential material is created by the conversion call and written directly to 0600 custody files by the tool (docs/ops/GITHUB-APP-PROCESS.md section 1A). Omit hook_attributes entirely: GitHub rejects {active: false} without a webhook URL.
